Introduction

This
document outlines the equipment inspection
I2, which must be performed
on an annually bases 
as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.

Cairo zone EETC

 and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy: EDEPC

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,

sections.text:
Environmental 
Precautions

Before using a blower to clean the outside compartment of the 
circuit breaker from dust, wear your breathing mask to 
protect your lung tissues from the dust 
particulate.

Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and send it to the 
dump.

Fix 
any oil leaks from connections, safety valve, bleeding washers, and motion 
transmission shaft to prevent pollution and save money of wasted oil.

Oil 
leaks to be ground have very bad impact on the environment, mainly on the soil 
and ground water and eventually on the ecosystem. It takes only 1 liter of 
Hydrocarbon spilled in an aquifer to render 1,000,000 liters of potable water 
useless for human consumption .

items:
Inspect visually all components of the circuit breaker for signs of overheating in the mechanism boxes, signs of electro 
 static discharge, small oil leaks, weld cracks, 
foundation, fixation of circuit breaker. 
 etc.
Check for AC and DC supply source.

Check
 all bolts and fasteners to ensure they are properly tightened, including
 mechanism bolts.

Check
 that all cable plugs are secure in their receptacles so proper contact will
 be made.

Check
 the earthing points of the circuit breaker to ensure they are secure and
 have not been damaged.

Ensure
 the pressure should be 330bar, check the oil pressure should be 330 bar at
 normal condition.

Check
 the operation of the hydraulic oil pump by reducing the hydraulic oil
 pressure
 (bleed a quantity of oil pack into the reservoir until the pump 
 starts) and check the function of the pressure switch operation and record 
 the stage of pump operation

Check 
 and record the number of hydraulic pump operations as indicated on the operation counter 
 and compare with the previous month.
Check and record the operation of the heater circuit of mechanism.

Check 
oil level of main tanks for three phases.
Check oil level of mechanism of parallel resistance

Check 
oil leaks for all connections.

Check 
oil leaks for safety valve.

Check 
oil leaks for bleeding washers.

Check 
oil leaks for motion transmission shaft (Ram).

Check 
all terminals connections also the pump terminals.

Oil 
bleeding must be done.

Check auxiliary switch 
terminal and all plugs regard connections cables

Check 
on / off coils.

Check
 the oil level of the paralleled resistor through the oil level indicators on
 the hydraulic mechanism of the resistor. Also check the level of hydraulic
 oil in the breaker operating mechanism.

Check
 and record the pressure in the accumulator, ensure that the initial pressure
 ~ 230 bar.

Check
 high-pressure pipes to ensure they are in their proper location and sealing
 properly.
Check the hydraulic oil reservoir tank to ensure the cap is sealing properly.

Retighten all bolts and earth connection of foundation and fixation of circuit 
breaker.

Clean 
all mechanism parts.

Check 
door gaskets for all panels.

Check 
SF6 humidity content air content < 2 %, acid content < 10 PPM.

Check gas dew point reference to MPIS approved document no. 
TD-SS-004- r0.

Check 
the contact resistance for circuit breaker & all compartment

Check 
on / off timing.
Measure SF6 pressure of circuit breaker.

Check 
gas pressure switch (for all stages)

Clean 
all outside compartment of circuit breaker from dust, oil and other things using 
blower and rags.
